heading: INT. FIELD HOSPITAL TENT - FLOODED VILLAGE - DAY

units.text: INT. FIELD HOSPITAL TENT - FLOODED VILLAGE - DAY
Rain drums on canvas.
Cots in rows, mud at the edges.
DR. ADAEZE NWOSU (40s, scrubs under a rain poncho) kneels by a cot where a small boy sleeps.
She checks his pulse, counts silently.
NURSE BARTEK (30s, big, gentle) holds a drip bag high.
He shifts it when she nods.
The boy's mother, LAKSHMI (30s, soaked sari), grips the cot rail.
She hasn't blinked in minutes.
OLD MR. FENN (70s, ham-radio volunteer) hovers at the flap with a clipboard.
His pulse is steady, Lakshmi.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: He's so cold.
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: He will be for a while. That's the water.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: She pulls a foil blanket over the boy and tucks it under his chin.
Colour's coming back, Doc.
units.name: BARTEK

units.text: Ravi. Ravi, beta.
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: She lowers her forehead to the rail and breathes out.
Her shoulders drop.
Doctor Nwosu, the boat's here for the next group.
units.name: MR. FENN

units.text: Tell them ten minutes, Mr. Fenn.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: He nods and leaves.
Bartek lowers the drip bag onto a hook.
You want me on the next cot, Doc?
units.name: BARTEK

units.text: Tea first, Bartek. You've been standing for six hours.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: He grins, tired.
She stands, knees cracking, and lays a hand on Lakshmi's back.
FADE OUT.
